style: Game asset sprite sheet for a cozy pastel fishing game (Cozy Lake style). Square 1:1 image split into a perfect 3x3 grid of 9 equal square cells, separated by clean, straight, evenly spaced pure white gutters. Every cell has a flat solid pure white (#FFFFFF) background and contains exactly ONE centered object that fills about 70% of the cell and never touches or crosses the cell edges. Art style: soft cel-shaded 3D cartoon, chunky rounded friendly shapes, gentle top-left lighting with one soft highlight, outlines in a slightly darker shade of each object's own color (never black), soft pastel palette (mint #7FD3B0, coral #FF9E80, sky blue #9AD4F5, warm gold #F2B544, lavender #B79CF2, cream #FFF8EC, slate #3D4B5C for small details). Same camera angle, scale and lighting in all 9 cells so they look like one matching set. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no frames, no cell borders, no background scenery, no cast shadow on the white background.
negative: text, letters, numbers, watermark, signature, black outline, photorealistic, noisy texture, gradient background, colored background, scenery, multiple objects in one cell, objects crossing cell borders, uneven grid, 4x4 grid, 2x2 grid, cropped objects
